text:
debrief db-021
1) the a-c-t-o-r a-t-t-e-m-p-t-e-d to b-y-p-a-s-s the f-a-c-i-a-l s-c-a-n g-a-t-e b-y u-s-i-n-g a r-e-c-o-r-d-e-d p-h-o-t-o, l-e-a-v-i-n-g a m-e-t-a-d-a-t-a t-r-a-c-e i-n the a-u-d-i-t l-o-g, a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the l-i-v-e-n-e-s-s v-e-r-i-f-y step.
2) they t-r-i-e-d to e-n-r-o-l-l a f-a-l-s-e i-d e-n-t-r-y u-s-i-n-g s-p-o-o-f-e-d c-a-m-e-r-a f-e-e-d s, l-e-a-v-i-n-g d-u-p-l-i-c-a-t-e r-e-c-o-r-d s in the e-n-r-o-l-l-m-e-n-t d-b, w-h-i-l-e i-g-n-o-r-i-n-g the m-u-l-t-i-f-a-c-t-o-r c-o-n-f-i-r-m check.
3) the t-e-a-m u-s-e-d a d-o-c-t-o-r'd b-a-d-g-e to w-a-l-k i-n-t-o the r-e-s-t-r-i-c-t-e-d z-o-n-e, l-e-a-v-i-n-g a b-a-d-g-e s-w-i-p-e e-n-t-r-y i-n the t-u-r-n-s-t-i-l-e l-o-g, a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the p-e-e-r v-e-r-i-f-y step.
4) they a-t-t-e-m-p-t-e-d to m-a-s-q-u-e-r-a-d-e the a-c-c-e-s-s l-o-g-s to i-m-i-t-a-t-e a v-a-l-i-d e-m-p-l-o-y-e-e, l-e-a-v-i-n-g t-i-m-e-s-t-a-m-p d-i-s-c-r-e-p-a-n-c-y, a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the f-o-r-e-n-s-i-c r-e-v-i-e-w step.
5) the e-x-e-r-c-i-s-e c-l-o-s-e-d a-f-t-e-r the i-n-c-i-d-e-n-t was d-o-c-u-m-e-n-t-e-d, l-e-a-v-i-n-g a c-a-s-e f-i-l-e a-t the i-c-c a-r-c-h-i-v-e, a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the p-o-s-t-i-n-c-i-d-e-n-t l-e-s-s-o-n-s m-e-e-t i-n-g.
